name: TOTP Sign-In Token Endpoint
summary: Maps password-challenge-bound mobile TOTP authentication to the normalized authentication flow and the existing access/refresh-token issuance pipeline.

sourceReferences.note: AllowAnonymous endpoint accepts TotpTokenSignInRequest containing MfaChallengeId, TOTP proof and the standard AuthRequest token metadata. Accepted proof is exchanged through the established single-use-token grant pipeline.
